name: verifier
text:
At-least-once delivery can run two verify jobs for the same run, and a fetch that never finishes can keep a run waiting forever. Make sure only one verifier works on a run at a time, and cap the rechecks.

The hidden tests rely on this interface:
- One verifier per run: `handleVerify` locks the run with a session advisory lock on `hashtext(runId)`, held on the client it connects from the pool. A job that finds the lock taken exits without changing the run.
- Rechecks: add an integer column `runs.rechecks` (default 0) in a new migration in `db/migrations/`. `recheckLater(db, boss, runId)` counts each recheck. When a run has already been rechecked 24 times, the next recheck marks it `failed` with error `fetches did not finish` and sends no job.
memory_tests: a failing lock query still releases the client
